notes.title: Major update (remastered version)!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32450335/d5d9c6503a259b677d97ecc33a7ef5015bb1321f.png[/img]

[b]ZD1 Remastered is available on Steam![/b]

List of changes:
- New poster and icon.
- Improved graphics (textures, effects, shadows, models).
- Improved interface.
- Improved car physics.
- Improved car handling.
- Improved tutorial level.
- Improved game launch in "Big Picture" mode.
- Improved gamepad controls.
- Tactile effects (vibration).
- Many other technical fixes.

[b]Get 60% off on Zombie Derby: [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/831770/Zombie_Derby/

Enjoy the game! 😎
